ledger_entries_account_normal_side.name: ledger_entries_account_normal_side
ledger_entries_account_normal_side.value:
(
        ("ledger_entries"."journal_type" = 'sale'
          AND (
            ("ledger_entries"."account" = 'accounts_receivable' AND "ledger_entries"."side" = 'debit')
            OR ("ledger_entries"."account" = 'sales_revenue' AND "ledger_entries"."side" = 'credit')
          ))
        OR
        ("ledger_entries"."journal_type" = 'sale_reversal'
          AND (
            ("ledger_entries"."account" = 'accounts_receivable' AND "ledger_entries"."side" = 'credit')
            OR ("ledger_entries"."account" = 'sales_revenue' AND "ledger_entries"."side" = 'debit')
          ))
      )

stock_movements_order_reference.name: stock_movements_order_reference
stock_movements_order_reference.value:
(
        ("stock_movements"."type" IN ('sale', 'sale_reversal') AND "stock_movements"."order_id" IS NOT NULL)
        OR
        ("stock_movements"."type" IN ('opening', 'adjustment') AND "stock_movements"."order_id" IS NULL)
      )
